name: omarchy-tools
description: Skills and helper scripts for working with Hyprland on Omarchy: live inspection, binding conflict checks, and config validation.

interface.shortDescription: Inspect and validate Hyprland changes on Omarchy.
interface.longDescription: Guidance and a read-only helper for changing Hyprland on Omarchy safely: find who owns a key binding, read window classes for rules, check monitor layout, and validate every change with a reload plus configerrors.
defaultPrompt: Check whether SUPER SHIFT B is already bound before I add a binding.
Show my monitor layout and help me change it.
Find the window class I need for a Hyprland window rule.
